priceSnapshot.note: Price is 76,614.2, up 1.56 percent on the 24-hour open of 75,440.2 and 137.9 points and 0.18 percent ABOVE the morning handover at 76,476.3. The headline number understates what happened. THE ADD GATE FIRED. The 15:00 UTC hour - 10:00 COT - settled at 76,780.1 against the 76,775.0 gate that had been refused on a close for three consecutive sessions, clearing it by 5.1 points. Before that the session took BOTH edges of the compression box within two hours: the 12:00 UTC hour ran to 77,167.3, which is 392.3 points through the ceiling and the highest trade since 15 September, and the 13:00 UTC hour flushed to 76,011.0, which is 39.4 points through the 76,050.4 reduce floor. A 1,156.3-point round trip on both sides of a box that had held 598.6 points of range all morning. The coil resolved exactly as the morning report said a coil that old resolves - hard, and in both directions before picking one. What it has NOT done is hold the break: price has given back 553.1 points from the high and sits 9.2 points under the 4H EMA20 at 76,623.44 and 160.8 points under the gate it cleared. Volatility is the cleanest confirmation that the regime changed - the 1H ATR14 is 462.25 against the morning's 388.73, up 18.9 percent, and the 15m ATR14 is 245.31 against 159.53, up 53.8 percent, reversing four sessions of decay in a single morning.

reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE below 76,050.4, UNCHANGED for a fourth session and now 563.8 points under the mark, which is 1.22 times the 462.25-point 1H ATR. The level earned the right to stay. Price traded 76,011.0 in the 13:00 UTC hour - 39.4 points THROUGH the trigger - and the hour closed 76,691.7, 641.3 points back above it, with every settled hourly close of the session landing between 76,500.8 and 76,780.1. That is the sixth time in ten sessions the settled-close requirement has kept this wallet out of a wick, and it is also a level that has now been swept and defended rather than merely untested. The 76,000 and 76,250 buckets cleared 2,083,407 USD of LONG liquidations on that flush, so the weak leverage under the market has already been taken out - the next visit finds less fuel, which is exactly why the gate does not need to move up.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE above 77,167.3, RAISED from 76,775.0 because that gate fired this session and the tranche behind it has been executed. The new level is the session high and the top of the 77,000 short-liquidation shelf, 553.1 points above the mark and 1.20 times the 1H ATR. The reason it is not set at 76,800 - just above the old gate - is that price has already been there and come back: a close at 76,800 would be a retest of a level the market has failed to hold twice today, not a continuation. A settled close above 77,167.3 clears the last short cluster on the tape and puts the 4H EMA50 at 77,190.17 and EMA100 at 77,239.73 in range, which is the first configuration since 14 September in which the 4H frame could actually turn. The settled-close requirement is unchanged and has now proven itself on the upside as well: it refused three tags that failed and passed the one that held.

decisionBox.changed: Position moves from ADD-pending to ADD-EXECUTED and the add gate steps up 392.3 points from 76,775.0 to 77,167.3. The reduce gate is unchanged at 76,050.4 for a fourth session. Confidence rises from 5.50 to 5.75 - the gate firing is a genuine upgrade, but the immediate 553.1-point fade from the high caps how much of an upgrade it can be. Bias stays RANGE with a BULLISH tilt; the probabilities shift 36/41/23 to 40/39/21.

liquidation.note: 1,852,791 USD across 242 fills in a 250-point bucket, of which 1,819,601 USD is SHORTS and only 33,190 USD longs - the heaviest and most one-sided cluster in the whole 16.3-hour window, and it sits 135.8 points above the mark. This is where the 77,167.3 push was paid for and where the 76,780.1 settled close was made. The honest caveat is the same one the morning report made: this is REALIZED liquidation, so the shorts in this band have already been carried out and the buying that did it is spent. Treat it as a shelf the market has proven it can reach, not as fuel still waiting to fire.

917,428 USD across 157 fills, 916,605 USD of it SHORTS - 99.9 percent one-sided, the cleanest single read on the tape. 385.8 points above the mark. This band only exists because price went there today; it was empty at the morning read. Whatever short supply sat between 76,875 and 77,125 has been removed, which is why a settled close above 77,167.3 is the honest next trigger rather than another tag of 77,000.

89,875 USD across 14 fills, all SHORTS. Thin, and it marks the exact point where the 77,167.3 push ran out of sellers to squeeze. Above here the tape has nothing on it, which cuts both ways: no resistance from forced buying, and no magnet pulling price up either.

947,426 USD across 128 fills, split 684,299 USD shorts against 263,127 USD longs - the only genuinely two-sided bucket on the tape and the one price is sitting on, 114.2 points under the mark. A two-sided cluster is what a fair-value shelf looks like: both books getting carried out at the same price means neither side owns it.

1,582,406 USD across 167 fills, of which 1,559,657 USD is LONGS - the second-largest cluster on the tape and the mirror image of the 76,750 band. 364.2 points below the mark. This is the 76,011.0 flush: the longs that had built up under the compression box were taken out here in the 13:00 UTC hour. Because it is realized, the read is that this fuel is GONE, which is the single best argument for the downside being thinner than it was this morning.

523,750 USD across 92 fills, 100 percent LONGS, 614.2 points below the mark and 50.4 points under the reduce gate. This is the bottom of the flush and it is exactly where the reduce level was drawn four sessions ago - the tape validated the level choice. Nothing on the tape below here at all in 16.3 hours.

liquidityMagnet.note: Pull is UP on distance and on weight. The nearest cluster above is 135.8 points away and carries 1,852,791 USD; the nearest below is 114.2 points away but carries 947,426 USD and is two-sided. Weighted across the whole tape, 3,533,129 USD of shorts were carried out against 2,380,548 USD of longs, 1.48 to 1, which has cooled from the morning's 1.99 to 1 as the flush added long liquidations back in. The caveat that matters: all of this is realized, both magnets have already been visited today, and a tape that has cleared both edges of its range in one morning is a tape with less to pull toward than it had at 07:00.

atr.source: Computed by this session from 400 verified OKX daily candles read in-browser, Wilder smoothing, settled buckets only. On the same verified series the 4H ATR14 is 878.73 (1.15 percent), the 1H ATR14 is 462.25 (0.60 percent) and the 15m ATR14 is 245.31 (0.32 percent). The fast frames REVERSED: the 1H reading is up 18.9 percent from the morning's 388.73 and the 15m up 53.8 percent from 159.53, ending four sessions of post-FOMC volatility decay in a single morning. The daily figure eased slightly from 2,253.12 as the 1,503.7-point Fed bar ages inside the 14-day window.

timeframes.structure: The fast frame has flipped back positive but price has slipped under the top of its own stack. 76,614.2 is 75.60 BELOW the EMA20 at 76,689.80, 43.95 above the EMA50 at 76,570.25, 181.80 above the EMA100 at 76,432.40 and 167.89 above the EMA200 at 76,446.31. Losing the EMA20 while holding the other three is what the back half of a failed push looks like. The MACD is the opposite reading and it is the better one: the histogram is PLUS 9.54 with the line at 65.44 over the signal at 55.90, a full recovery from the morning's minus 22.62, and both the line and the signal are far above where they sat at 07:00. RSI at 51.46 is barely changed from 52.34 and still pinned to the midline. The stack order also repaired itself - the EMA200 has dropped back below the EMA50, undoing the tangle the morning flagged.

scalpContext.intradayBias: The box broke and then refused to run. Both edges were taken inside two hours - 77,167.3 at the top, 76,011.0 at the bottom - and price has settled back into the upper middle at 76,614.2. The working range is now 76,439.50 to 77,167.3 and the immediate battleground is a 105-point band between the 4H EMA20 at 76,623.44 and the 1H EMA100 at 76,718.83: price is BETWEEN them, which is the single least informative place on the chart. Longs only on a settled hourly close back above 76,775.0, with the 1H EMA20 at 76,457.91 as the fail-fast line; shorts only on a settled hourly close under 76,439.50, the 1H EMA50, which would undo twenty-two hours of holding it and reopen 76,250.0. The volatility regime changed today - 1H ATR 462.25 against 388.73 this morning, 15m ATR 245.31 against 159.53 - so stops that were sized for the coil are now too tight. Size down, not up.
scalpContext.note: Scalp only the edges — live signals come from the chart, not this report.

Funding is plus 0.01 percent, the flat baseline rather than a crowded number, and the perpetual trades at 76,570.0 against a 76,605.4 index with a minus 0.000433 premium - the perp is still BELOW spot after a 1,156-point round trip, which is the least frothy configuration this report has recorded during an up-move all month.

calibration.note: The morning 76,050.4 reduce gate did NOT fire, but for the first time this week it was genuinely threatened: price traded 76,011.0 in the 13:00 UTC hour, 39.4 points THROUGH the trigger, while the lowest settled hourly close was 76,500.8, leaving 450.4 points of clearance on the measure that counts. Sixth save in ten sessions for the settled-close rule and the first one where the wick actually crossed the line. The 76,775.0 add gate DID FIRE - the 15:00 UTC hour settled 76,780.1, clearing it by 5.1 points after three consecutive sessions of being tagged on price and refused on a close. That pattern is now RESOLVED, and it resolved upward. The 74,955.5 INVALIDATION held with 1,658.7 points of clearance. No resting stop was recommended and none was needed. Directionally morning published RANGE with a BULLISH tilt at 36 bull against 23 bear and price is 137.9 points and 0.18 percent HIGHER, so the call was right in sign. Discretionary: morning BOUGHT a 6.00 USDT spot tranche at 76,476.3 and spot marks 76,614.2, so the tranche is 137.9 points onside, roughly plus 0.011 USDT on a 6 USDT slice - small, but true, and it vindicates the decision to keep the tranche small while refusing to sit out. What did NOT resolve is the 13 September flush rule, now at its TENTH test. The liquidation leg still passes at 1.48-to-1 shorts and the account-ratio leg passes emphatically at 1.66, a fourth consecutive decline and the lowest of the week. The OPEN-INTEREST leg FAILS again: 2,196,790,542 USD against the morning's 2,189,616,962, up 0.33 percent while price rose. It is the mildest failure of the ten - a third of the previous sessions' build rate, and OI is still 0.25 percent below the endday peak - but a build is a build. Ten tests, no clean pass, and 74,955.5 remains explicitly NOT confirmed as a flush low.
